# Vehicle Lab

> Local-first automotive engineering software for OEM and Tier-1 calibration teams. MDF4 analysis, AI-assisted diagnostics, and ECU calibration tooling that runs on-premise, with no license server and no data leaving the customer's network.

Vehicle Lab builds a suite of desktop tools for automotive engineers working with measurement data files, ECU calibration, and vehicle diagnostics. The suite is designed for data-sovereignty-sensitive environments such as OEM powertrain teams.

## Products

- [DiagAI](https://vehiclelab.in/diagai): AI-assisted vehicle diagnostics assistant for interpreting fault codes and sensor data.
- [CIE Pro](https://vehiclelab.in/cie_pro): ECU calibration and instrumentation environment for tuning and validation work.
- [HELIX](https://vehiclelab.in/helix): ECU calibration data management for A2L/base dataset upload, DCM/CDFX/PACO patch governance, validation, release control, and final ECU file generation.
- [Hexx](https://vehiclelab.in/hexx): A2L-aware hex and binary editor for ECU calibration — opens Intel HEX, Motorola S-record and raw BIN images, decodes them into named calibration maps, edits in engineering units, and recomputes checksums on write.
- [MDX](https://vehiclelab.in/mdx): Professional MDF4/MF4 data analysis lab for inspecting and processing measurement files.
- [XHandbook](https://vehiclelab.in/xhandbook): ECU documentation explorer for navigating and searching ECU reference handbooks.

## Notes

- All products are designed to run on-premise/local-first; no customer data is sent to external license or telemetry servers by default.
- Vehicle Lab is currently in pilot with select Tier-1 powertrain teams; general access is via sales/demo, not self-serve signup.
